checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Only person is the blonde woman
must.why: Final portrait shows only one woman.

must.item: Face, short blonde hairstyle and smile recognisable
must.why: Same bob and warm smile. Face looks slightly older and more refined, and small earrings were added, but it is plausibly the same person.
No trace of the man in either output.

must.item: Beach replaced with professional clothing and unobtrusive backdrop
must.why: Navy blazer and white blouse in front of a blurred office with plants.

must.item: Square head-and-shoulders portrait, natural lighting, no artifacts
must.why: Output is portrait 4:5 (about 928x1152), not square. Lighting is natural and there are no obvious artifacts.

faults.what: Aspect ratio is about 4:5 portrait, not the square the brief expects
Face is slightly altered and looks older and more polished than the source. Earrings were added.
Crop is loose, with shoulders and torso. The window and plants in the background are busy but blurred.

summary: A polished professional headshot of the blonde woman in a blazer against a blurred office; it is recognisable and clean, but not square and the face drifted slightly.
